name: Non Financial Request Type 2 Code
definition: Type of non financial request that could be processed between an Acceptor and an Intermediary Agent or an Acquirer.

ACQR.name: Acquirer Selection
ACQR.definition: According to several parameters of a transaction, an Intermediary Agent helps an Acceptor to identify the more relevant Acquirer to process the transaction.

PARQ.name: Par Request
PARQ.definition: The Intermediary Agent or Acquirer provides the PaymentAccountReference to use to process the transaction.

RISK.name: Risk Management
RISK.definition: The Intermediary Agent or Acquirer helps the Acceptor to assess the risk management of the transaction.

TOKN.name: Token Request
TOKN.definition: The Intermediary Agent or Acquirer provides the token to use to process the transaction.

ADDR.name: Additional Request
ADDR.definition: Indicates a request which implies to receive additional information.

INSM.name: Instalment Plan Request
INSM.definition: Request to receive acquirer instalment plans.
